label: Resync operation (Sync Gateway)
type: the operation reprocessing every existing document in a database's bucket to recompute channel routing and access assignments after the sync function itself has changed - required because a sync-function edit has no effect on already-stored documents until they are next revised. Requires the database offline first; runs the sync function with admin-level permissions (requireUser/requireAccess/requireRole calls always succeed during a resync). Running it on more than one node without persistent configuration produces undefined behaviour, with no described recovery procedure if that happens.
note: Directly answers the round's framing question for manage/: reuses existing access-control vocabulary (sgw:sync-function, the require*Cmd family, sgw:channel-access-revocation) as the objects of genuinely NEW relations - a middle case between full reuse and round 26's zero-precedent state-transition family. Round 3's access-control extraction never anticipated 'what happens when the sync function changes after documents already exist.'
